feedback: Decision: approve. This candidate changes one sensing field from the best raced design (iteration 6, score 85.60): the sensor spread goes from ±0.05 m to ±0.08 m, with weights, kp, ki, kd, base_speed and line_loss unchanged. Earlier evidence supports testing it. Iterations 2 and 3 show the ±0.05 m spread with 12 mm sensors gave 0 oval line-loss events. Iteration 6 (±0.05 m, 16 mm, kd 0.30, speed 1.0, search_left) gave 0 oval line losses but max_error 0.0623, so the outer edge is the untested lever on the oval. On s-bend and slalom, line_loss_events stayed at 1 under last_direction (iterations 0 to 3), search_right (iteration 4), and search_left (iterations 5 to 6), so recovery direction and speed have not moved those tracks. Sensing span is the remaining untested variable there. Iteration 7 (kd 0.20) cut oval progress from 0.3425 to 0.115, so keep kd at 0.30. Read the race as follows. (a) If oval progress stays near the iteration 6 value (0.3425) and line_loss_events on s-bend and slalom fall below 1, keep the ±0.08 m spread. (b) If oval progress falls well below 0.3425, or the score falls below 85.60, revert to the ±0.05 m spread and approve that design, since it is the best raced design. (c) If s-bend and slalom still show one line loss each with the wider array, stop tuning the spread. Next, test a fifth forward sensor at y 0.06 with the ±0.05 m spread, keeping the controller fixed. Do not treat this candidate as better than iteration 6 until the race shows it. The expected-result claims in the rationale are hypotheses only, not evidence.
requested_changes: If oval progress falls well below 0.3425 or the score drops below 85.60 at ±0.08 m, revert sensor x positions to -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05 m and keep all other fields at iteration 6 values. Evidence: iteration 6 is the best raced design, and iterations 2 and 3 show the ±0.05 m spread removed oval line losses.

If s-bend or slalom line_loss_events are still 1 each with the ±0.08 m spread, test a fifth forward sensor at x 0, y 0.06 (weight 0) or similar, holding the spread and controller fixed. Evidence: line_loss stayed at 1 under last_direction, search_right and search_left on both tracks (iterations 0 to 6).

Keep kd at 0.30 and base_speed at 1.0. Evidence: iteration 7 (kd 0.20) cut oval progress from 0.3425 to 0.115, and iteration 2 (kd 0.15) cut s-bend and slalom progress, so damping is not the lever to change now.
